description: A Java class named NetListMerge that appears to perform merging of component sections from multiple KiCad netlist files. It reads, parses, validates, and combines components, libparts, libraries, and nets sections into a single netlist file.

classes.name: NetContent
classes.description: A container class holding sections of a netlist: header, components, libparts, libraries, and nets.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the program that merges components sections from multiple netlist files.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a string content of a netlist file to extract header, components, libparts, libraries, and nets sections.
